title: Spicy Calamarata Pasta
description: A spicy twist on traditional Japanese pasta, featuring calamarata and a kick of heat. Perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the calamarata pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, cook the spicy italian sausage over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the soy sauce, brown sugar, and red pepper flakes to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked calamarata pasta to the skillet and toss with the spicy sauce.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with green onions.
